Reference to the ItemCode element of the item node in the Product (HierarchicalStructures) submodel, or the ProductCode of the EntryNode for finished products; left empty for consumables without a product node.
칸에 보관하는 품목의 ItemCode(Product / 품목 노드) 항목을 가리키는 참조, 완제품은 ProductCode(Product / EntryNode) 항목을 가리킴

List of storage sections in the factory; each section has its own storage conditions and operating resources.

List of item categories stored in the section.
List of storage slots within the category, one slot per stored item.

List of suppliers delivering the stored item.
Reference to the WorkerGroupCode element of the WorkerGroup (Resource submodel) that receives, stores and issues items in the section.
